roleHints.USER: Can use the user app only. Cannot sign in to admin.
roleHints.JOB_ADMIN: Can sign in to admin and manage shared job postings only.
roleHints.USER_ADMIN: Can sign in to admin to register regular users, edit their profile, and fill their experience library.
roleHints.ADMIN: Has every admin capability, including users, shared jobs, and other users' experiences.

deploySettings.title: Deploy CI Settings
deploySettings.subtitle: Enable or disable E2E tests that run automatically after each master push.
deploySettings.aiE2eDesc: After deploy, Playwright validates experience → job → RAG → resume generation. Calls the external AI API configured in Admin.
deploySettings.e2eDesc: Validates landing, signup, and workspace UI flows. Does not use LLM.
deploySettings.note2: Changes apply from the next push deploy. No Docker restart required.
deploySettings.loadError: Could not load settings. Make sure you are signed in with an administrator account.

llmSettings.title: LLM Provider Settings
llmSettings.subtitle: Resume generation calls an external AI API. Pick models, keys, and failover here. No LLM is hosted on this server.
llmSettings.providersDesc: Save an OpenAI-compatible API key (DeepSeek, Gemini, etc.), then enable the provider for routes.
llmSettings.routesDesc: Priority 1 is primary, 2 is fallback, etc. Same provider with a different model is allowed. Use the provider's model ID exactly.
llmSettings.revealKeyDesc: {{name}} ({{slug}}) — Sensitive. Do not share in chat or screenshots.
llmSettings.revealKeyDescGeneric: Sensitive. Do not share in chat or screenshots.
llmSettings.revealKeyError: Could not load the API key.
llmSettings.validationModelDup: This operation already has the same provider and model. Only different models are allowed.
llmSettings.note1: Set INTERNAL_API_TOKEN and LLM_ENCRYPTION_KEY in server .env so resume-ai can read DB keys.
llmSettings.note2: Chat operations (generate, analysis, etc.) use the priority-1 model. Gemini Flash and Flash-Lite have separate daily quotas, so they can be used as failover.
llmSettings.note3: Manage LLM API keys in Admin only. Keep INTERNAL_API_TOKEN, LLM_ENCRYPTION_KEY, and EMBEDDING_DIMENSION in .env. OPENAI_* is env fallback only.
